cases.prompt: A tendon specimen's apparent modulus doubles when pull direction changes. Explain why this need not be a measurement error and propose the metadata needed to compare the values across labs.

rubric.criterion: Identifies anisotropy or orientation-dependent fiber recruitment
Mentions nonlinear/viscoelastic behavior or preload/strain-rate effects
Specifies orientation, geometry, hydration, temperature, strain rate, and modulus definition

limitations: This preserved three-criterion checklist is self-assessment, not an analytic grading rubric or an institutional grade.

cases.prompt: Rotor project milestone 1 (suggested week 11). For candidates A, B and C, calculate the angular speed in rad/s and rpm needed for the shared hypothetical 600 × g target at each sample radius.

rubric.criterion: I used ω = √(600 × 9.81/r) with each candidate's own sample radius.
I converted each ω to rpm with rpm = 60ω/(2π) and kept units on both.
I explained why equal targets need different speeds at different radii.
I checked my method on the open rehearsal before using the project candidates.

limitations: Optional self-check for the fictional rotor trade-off project. The response is saved privately and is never submitted, scored or graded; the separate inactive project draft remains unreviewed.

I checked the result against K = ¼ M R × 600 × 9.81.
